evals.prompt: Use the hello-world widget to greet "world".
evals.expected_output: Skill activates: the prompt asks for the hello-world widget with a concrete name. The model builds a payload of {"name": "world"}, pipes it through render.py, and calls visualize:show_widget with the rendered bundle. The widget mounts and renders "Hello, world!".

evals.prompt: Show me the visill hello-world widget. My name is Ada.
evals.expected_output: Skill activates: the model extracts the name from context, constructs a payload of {"name": "Ada"}, renders it through scripts/render.py, and invokes visualize:show_widget. The widget renders "Hello, Ada!" and exposes the submission button.
Skill does NOT activate: a conversational greeting is not a request to render a widget. The model replies in plain text without invoking visualize:show_widget.
